decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.0%, S&P 500 +0.1%) with no clear directional signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 threshold needed to fund a meaningful new position, so we held all 7 existing positions rather than forcing a trade.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with the NASDAQ flat and the S&P 500 up a marginal 0.1%. This kind of low-volatility, directionless session typically reflects investors waiting for a fresh catalyst rather than reacting to major news. Without a strong signal in either direction, the safest approach is to hold existing positions and let profit targets and stop-losses do their work.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢近乎橫行,納指持平,標普500僅微升0.1%。呈現低波動、缺乏方向性的交易日,通常反映投資者在等待新的市場催化劑,而非對重大消息作出反應。在缺乏明確方向訊號的情況下,最穩妥的做法是持有現有倉位,讓止賺及止蝕機制自動發揮作用。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept in reserve rather than fully invested. Today our available cash ($189.29) was too small to open a meaningful new position even with open slots and bullish candidates on the screener, so the disciplined move is to hold the cash rather than under-size a trade just to deploy it.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「彈藥儲備」(Dry Powder)指刻意保留現金而非全數投入市場。今日雖然有空置倉位及多隻具動能的候選股,但可用現金僅$189.29,不足以建立有意義的新倉位。因此,持有現金而非勉強縮小注碼進場,才是較有紀律的做法。
